skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze economic policies related to international trade and investment.
Understand and apply theories of international trade.
Apply appropriate research methods and techniques for data collection and analysis.
Use statistical tools and software for analyzing economic data.
Evaluate the effectiveness of economic policies using quantitative and qualitative methods.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze complex economic issues.
Identify and solve problems related to economic policies and international trade.
Demonstrate self-motivation and independence in learning and research.
Effectively communicate research findings through written reports and presentations.
Work collaboratively with peers and mentors on research projects.
